title: fdachange: Epidemic Change-Point Tests for Functional Data
description: Weighted scan tests for epidemic (changed-segment) alternatives in scalar and functional data: an antisymmetric-kernel (Wilcoxon-type) scan, an Lp-type scan of the weighted empirical process, a kernel mean-embedding (RKHS) scan, and the CUSUM-type statistic of Birbilas (2025), with precomputed Monte-Carlo critical values, functional-to-scalar projections and curve reconstruction. R package with a Python twin.
